title: The Horizon of New Lagos Anew
author: Wren Thackeray
blurb: Astrid Delacroix, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
